items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: But I did get a chance to meet Joe in 1939 at the Famous Door... and that was when I met Joe Jones.

ctx.x: I think Count Basie's band came to New York in 1937. Did you ever run into that band with Joe Jones in that band, when Joe Jones was playing drums there?
